About the job

Senior React Native Engineer (Mobile) - Remote


Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world’s most innovative products (Brands you’ve heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!).


We are looking for Senior React Native Engineers, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile applications that support millions of users, and committed to solid architectural judgment and engineering best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and collaborating closely with designers, product, and backend teams to ship reliable, well-crafted mobile experiences.


What you’ll build and own

  • Build and ship production mobile features end-to-end in React Native, owning your work from implementation through deployment across Android and iOS.
  • Design and implement mobile solutions following best practices and scalable architecture patterns.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and manage application state using tools such as Redux, MobX, or Recoil.
  • Make architecture decisions around performance, responsiveness, and reliability across platforms.
  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews and technical discussions.


Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile development, with hands-on work in React Native.
  • Deep understanding of mobile architecture, UI frameworks, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience integrating RESTful APIs and managing state using tools such as Redux, MobX, or Recoil.
  • Experience with modern git workflows and agile development practices.
  • Proven React Native upgrade experience, with legacy or unsupported upgrades strongly preferred.
  • A genuine bar for clean, testable, robust code, backed by sound testing habits.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.


Nice-to-Have

  • AI-forward mindset with active use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).
  • Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play.
  • Familiarity with native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) codebases.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for mobile projects and over-the-air update tools like CodePush.
  • Availability to work aligned with the partner's time zone.


Additional

  • US Timezone Overlap: 5h–6h daily PST
